material.subject: Is each of the 52 deleted .gm/receipts paths byte-identical between HEAD and its last-touch commit, so the recorded forensic reference reproduces the deleted content exactly?
material.witness_evidence: All 52 deleted paths: no content change between last-touch commit and HEAD. trav-gm-6 directory diffs (bc59453b..HEAD, d555745a..HEAD) list only files whose last touch is a later commit (05, 06, 07), consistent with per-file last-touch mapping.
